pages.title: Quantum Codex
pages.text: This notebook. Its pages are bound with a sliver of Cherenkov Quartz in the spine, so entries glow faintly when there is something new to read. It holds every observation, sketch and wrong turn I have made, and it grows thicker every time I return from the field.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I found an older edition in an observatory ruin, half the entries water-damaged. I bound a book with a quartz spine and began copying it out, adding my own notes. Most of the handwriting in here is mine now.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Observatory Ruin chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.
